design_system.name: Atlas Talent Vault Design System

core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Executive Seriousness with AI Modernity
Emotion First: Trust, Authority, and Precision
Content is King: Data density with breathing room
Negative Space: Use it to separate complex data sets
Contrast: High contrast for readability in data-heavy views

theme_strategy.description: Professional Light Mode (The 'Paper' Metaphor) for high-readability data work. Optional 'Executive Dark Mode' for low-light focus.

usage_rules: HEADINGS: Use 'Manrope' for all H1-H4. Tight tracking (-0.02em).
BODY: Use 'Inter' for all paragraphs, inputs, and table data.
NUMBERS/DATA: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for IDs, salaries, and metrics.
WEIGHTS: Avoid 'Bold' (700) for body text. Use 'Medium' (500) for emphasis.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-sm shadow-sm font-medium px-6 py-2.5 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm font-medium px-6 py-2.5

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200/60 shadow-sm rounded-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.style: h-11 bg-white border-slate-200 focus:border-slate-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-slate-900 rounded-sm transition-all

badges.style: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase

rules: No jagged bottoms. Use h-full on children.

forbidden: Generic HTML date pickers (Use Shadcn Calendar)

universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts or unstyled gradients.
Ensure all text has adequate contrast (WCAG AA).
Do not use transparent backgrounds on headers without blur/scrim.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'Manrope' font via Google Fonts in index.html or import in index.css.
Implement the 'Atlas' sidebar layout: Fixed left sidebar (slate-900), scrollable main content (slate-50).
Use 'Card' components for all dashboard widgets but remove shadows until hover.
For the Candidate Table: Use a 'dense' table style with sticky headers and zebra striping (odd: bg-white, even: bg-slate-50/50).
AI Features (Atlas AI) should always use the 'AI Teal' (#06B6D4) color for icons or badges to distinguish from human actions.
